note: Rationale and rules: envelope/v0 README 2.3.2. The contract is the source; tributary.sdk.codes is checked against this file by a tributary-sdk test (ENGINE_CODES == codes + log_only; RESERVED_PREFIXES == reserved_prefixes). A channel's Reject(code) may not use any code listed here or any code under a reserved prefix. Codes only, never values: this file is PHI-free by construction.

reserved_prefixes.owner: http and fhir loaders: HTTP_<status>, HTTP_REDIRECT_REFUSED (channel-spec README 3.4)
sftp loader and source: SFTP_<status> (channel-spec README 3.4)
sftp loader and source: SSH_HOST_KEY_MISMATCH, SSH_AUTH_FAILED (channel-spec README 3.4)
mllp loader: MLLP_AE, MLLP_AR, MLLP_TIMEOUT, MLLP_NO_ACK (channel-spec README 3.4.6)
kafka loader: KAFKA_<librdkafka error name> (channel-spec README 3.4.7)

codes.meaning: One registered header malformed on an identifiable record (envelope 2.3, 2.3.1)
Record cannot be identified; quarantine wrapper (envelope 2.3.1, 5.2)
A pipeline or destination step raised on every attempt (stepRetries exhausted)

codes.emitter: runtime executor, wave 1 to W2-5 builds only
codes.meaning: Pre-fix spelling of TRANSFORM_ERROR (envelope 2.3.2). Not emitted once the executor is corrected
A record the pipeline built fails the envelope at produce time (size, header count or a header rule). The CONSUMED record is dead-lettered with its raw payload; nothing is produced for it
One consumed record outlasted its processing budget, sized under max.poll.interval.ms. The consumed record is dead-lettered instead of evicting the consumer in a loop
The executor returned neither a message nor a drop
Local producer queue full; back-pressure
The Kafka client refused the produce call
Records still queued when the flush deadline passed
A delivery callback reported failure
A Kafka transaction was aborted
The destination circuit breaker is open
Could not connect to the destination (channel-spec README 3.4)
Peer certificate verification failed (channel-spec README 3.4)
Transport failure after connecting
timeoutMs elapsed (channel-spec README 3.4)
Payload is not the shape the destination type requires (channel-spec README 3.4.3)
onUnresolved: reject and the field did not resolve (channel-spec README 3.3.2)
Not HL7 v2 ER7, claim-checked, or no leading MSH (channel-spec README 3.3.2)
A segment in requireSegments does not occur (channel-spec README 3.3.2)
MSH-12.1 absent or not listed in version (channel-spec README 3.3.2)
More than 10,000 children (channel-spec README 3.3.2 split rule 4)
Input the splitter cannot read (channel-spec README 3.3.2)

log_only.meaning: Internal reason below RECORD_UNDECODABLE / HEADER_PARSE_ERROR (envelope 2.3). Never in a header or event
